items.title: Trusted by people of the Greater Toronto Area

c: Is your old, unused trampoline becoming a safety hazard in your backyard? What was once a fun recreational feature may now be rusted, torn, or unstable – creating potential dangers for children and detracting from your outdoor space. Over time, even quality trampolines can deteriorate with weather exposure, becoming eyesores that take up valuable yard space.

One call to our professional team transforms your problematic trampoline into a cleared space ready for new activities. We carefully assess each trampoline demolition project to determine the safest removal approach, accounting for factors like frame condition, spring tension, and mat deterioration. For metal frame trampolines, we use specialized tools to safely dismantle the structure. Netting and padding removal follows strict safety protocols, while the entire unit is broken down for proper recycling or disposal.

blocks.text: Break Free from Damaged trampoline – trampoline Demolition Made Easy

c: That worn-out trampoline isn’t repairing itself. What was once a smooth, attractive surface has become a patchwork of cracked tiles, warped boards, and stubborn adhesives. The materials are breaking apart, the underlayment is failing, and every day it remains makes your space look more dated.

We specialize in making problematic floors disappear quickly, safely, and affordably. Our professional floor demolition service starts at just {{cad_125}}, and we handle every step from pulling up the first layer to final cleanup of your subfloor.

We take care of all the tough work: carefully removing demolition tile floor layers, extracting stubborn adhesives, eliminating every last nail and staple, and hauling away all debris. For concrete floor demolition, we use specialized equipment to break up and remove slabs efficiently.
Ready to reclaim your space? Call us at +1 647 922 5865 or book online.

blocks.text: Same-Day Trampoline Demolition Service in Your Neighborhood

c: That outdated trampoline isn’t just unattractive, it’s a potential safety hazard many homeowners underestimate. Proper floor demolition involves far more than simply pulling up tiles or planks, with hidden challenges like stubborn adhesives, uneven subfloors, and hazardous materials lurking beneath the surface.

Our professional trampoline demolition team eliminates these risks by managing every aspect of your project. Whether you’re preparing for a beautiful new floor installation, eliminating tripping hazards, or simply tired of living with damaged surfaces, we offer same-day and next-day demolition services throughout the area. Our experienced crews handle all types of trampoline demolition with specialized equipment and techniques to protect your subfloor while completely clearing the way for your renovation.

items.q: Do you remove all types of trampoline, including tile, hardwood, and carpet?
a: Yes, we professionally remove all trampoline types, including ceramic tile, natural stone, hardwood, laminate, vinyl, carpet, and concrete floors. Our team is equipped to handle any material or adhesive type.

items.q: How much does trampoline demolition cost?
a: Our trampoline demolition services depend on the area, with final pricing depending on the material type, adhesive difficulty, and subfloor condition. We provide free, no-obligation estimates.

items.q: What areas do you serve for trampoline removal?
a: We serve homeowners and businesses across Bradford, Port Perry, Pickering, Richmond Hill, Scarborough, Schomberg, Mississauga, Newmarket, and throughout the Greater Toronto Area.

items.q: Do I need to prepare the area before demolition?
a: No preparation is needed – our crew handles everything from furniture moving to final cleanup. We recommend removing small valuables and fragile items as a precaution.

items.q: How long does trampoline demolition take?
a: Most single-room projects take 2-4 hours, while whole-home trampoline removal typically takes 1-2 days. Same-day service is available for urgent projects.
